gen-dafont-disorder-rubik: Disorder throws down raw, unswelling curves with a tall lowercase and glyphs kept well apart, while Rubik follows in soft, rounded forms. Chaos meets a plain sans.
gen-dafont-dogica-bitter: Heavy and commanding, Dogica spreads its wide-tracked letters across the top, with every curve left visibly open. Bitter grounds them with a slab-serif body.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-epunda-slab: Dignified and a bit old-fashioned, Epunda Slab sets tall rounded lowercase beneath Dogica, whose heavy wide-tracked capitals nearly match its small letters. Raw weight meets a text serif.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads like a text serif with a literary hush, its tall middle band tucked between shallow ascenders. Under Dogica's heavy, widely spaced heading, a long page would settle into dignified, bookish quiet.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-glegoo: Commanding from the first word, Dogica stamps heavy, wide-spaced letters with open curves. Glegoo takes over where reading begins, its big counters and unclosed curves giving a classic serif refined, editorial manners.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-hanuman: Hanuman brings a traditional serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on its s, quietly refined. And beneath Dogica's heavy headline, a long page would read in steady, dignified rows.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-kadwa: Heavy and brash, Dogica opens the pair. Dogica commands attention with wide spacing, while Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height, carries the editorial reading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noticia-text: Blocky, loud and wide-spaced, this one grabs you. Dogica is built for commanding headlines, while Noticia Text, a text serif with big curve entrances and full-height lowercase, handles the literary reading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-pridi: Dogica leads with heavy, wide-tracked letters, its curves left open at every end and its lowercase nearly capital height. Pridi then adds a refined serif with generous gaps beside the stems, so small letters stand proud.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-scope-one: Widely tracked, heavy letters with open curve ends define Dogica, and its lowercase almost matches the capitals. But Scope One, a text serif with spilling counters and stubby ascenders, brings the traditional refinement.
